products.name: DemoPrint TP-58
products.visual_features: Compact black thermal receipt printer. Paper slot on top, round FEED button and blue LED on the front, white front label reading 'DemoPrint TP-58'. Same housing and front controls as TP-80, but narrower.

products.name: DemoPrint TP-80
products.visual_features: Wider black thermal receipt printer with an auto-cutter. Same housing and front controls as TP-58 (round FEED button, blue LED), plus a small OPEN button on top. White front label reading 'DemoPrint TP-80'.

products.name: DemoScan BS-100
products.visual_features: Dark grey pistol-grip handheld barcode scanner with a green trigger and a red scan window. 'DemoScan' printed on the head and 'BS-100' on the handle.

products.name: DemoCash CD-40
products.visual_features: Low dark steel cash drawer with a round key lock on the front and a front label reading 'DemoCash CD-40'.
